selection: Original overall inner-fold MAE and original ridge alpha grid. No outer-guided selection.

generator.bands: Low <2, Middle 2 to <4, High >=4; sampling strata only, target remains continuous
generator.ordinal_policy: Round interpolated 1-5 numeric responses to nearest integer, halves upward; retain identical category values.
generator.fallback: If a band has no eligible pairs, add no records for it. Never invent a neighbor or target.
generator.interpretation: These are local interpolated pseudo-observations, not validated human responses or new independent evidence. Plausible ranges and local provenance do not establish causal or psychological validity.

interpretation: Exploratory same-sample regression follow-up selected after previous results. Generate only within each inner/outer fit. Evaluate only untouched real students. Duplication controls whether any benefit comes from reweighting rather than interpolation. Do not report generated records as survey participants.
